description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Integrated Campaign Manager based in Luxembourg. As an Integrated Campaign Manager, you will lead the strategy, development, and execution of multi-channel marketing campaigns designed to generate qualified leads, build sales pipeline, and accelerate revenue growth. Working in a fully remote, international environment, you will collaborate closely with marketing, sales, product marketing, brand, events, and operations teams to create a seamless buyer journey. You will take ownership of campaign planning, channel selection, budget allocation, and performance optimization, ensuring that every initiative contributes to measurable business outcomes. By combining creative messaging with data-driven insights, you will continuously refine campaigns to improve engagement, conversion, and return on investment. You will also explore AI-powered tools and emerging technologies to enhance personalization, streamline workflows, and scale campaign execution. This role is ideal for a strategic, results-oriented B2B marketer who thrives in a collaborative environment and wants to make a direct impact on global business growth. Accountabilities Develop, execute, and optimize integrated, multi-channel demand generation campaigns to attract new prospects, generate qualified pipeline, and accelerate existing sales opportunities. Design quarterly campaign plans that balance ongoing demand generation programs with high-impact initiatives across the prospect lifecycle, aligning channel selection and budget allocation with pipeline and revenue targets. Manage campaigns across multiple channels, including content syndication, webinars, virtual events, email nurturing, direct mail, referral programs, and product demonstration initiatives. Collaborate with product marketing and brand teams to translate positioning and value propositions into compelling campaign messaging, relevant offers, and engaging content. Develop sales enablement materials, including talk tracks, email templates, and one-pagers, while aligning with business development representatives on follow-up processes to convert campaign engagement into qualified meetings. Coordinate campaign timelines, budgets, resources, and external vendors to ensure efficient execution and measurable return on investment. Work closely with marketing, sales, and operations stakeholders to maintain consistent messaging, clear priorities, and coordinated campaign delivery. Monitor campaign performance through analytics, attribution, and pipeline reporting, using A/B testing and other optimization techniques to improve results. Identify and implement opportunities to leverage AI and emerging technologies for audience research, segmentation, personalization, content development, distribution, reporting, and workflow automation. Conduct campaign retrospectives, translate performance insights into actionable improvements, and develop repeatable processes and playbooks to support scalable growth. Requirements At least six years of experience in B2B integrated marketing, demand generation, growth marketing, or account-based marketing, with substantial ownership of campaign strategy and execution. A proven track record of developing and managing campaigns that contribute directly to pipeline generation, pipeline coverage, and revenue growth rather than focusing exclusively on engagement metrics. Strong understanding of multi-channel marketing strategies, campaign planning, audience segmentation, lead nurturing, and conversion optimization. Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including sales, product marketing, brand, digital marketing, events, and operations. Data-driven mindset with practical knowledge of marketing attribution, campaign analytics, pipeline measurement, performance reporting, and A/B testing. Hands-on experience using AI tools to support campaign planning, content creation, personalization, workflow automation, or marketing operations. Experience working with Salesforce and HubSpot, or equivalent customer relationship management (CRM) and marketing automation platforms. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present campaign strategies, performance insights, and recommendations clearly to senior stakeholders. Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns, competing priorities, budgets, and deadlines in a distributed environment. Fluency in written and spoken English, along with reliable home internet access and the ability to work effectively in a remote setting. A proactive, adaptable, and collaborative approach, with a commitment to continuous improvement, experimentation, and measurable business impact. Candidates are encouraged to apply even if they do not meet every listed criterion. Transferable skills, relevant experience, and the potential to contribute to the role are also valued. Benefits Fully remote work: Work from home or another authorized location, with flexibility to work across eligible countries and distributed teams. Flexible paid time off: Enjoy 40 days off per year, including holidays and vacation, or more where required by local regulations. Mental health support: Access to a dedicated mental well-being service through Plumm. Well-being allowance: Receive a monthly allowance through the ThanksBen wallet to spend on eligible well-being services and activities. Flexible parental leave: At least three months of paid parental leave for eligible new parents, with job protection for up to 12 months or as required by local law. Home office support: Receive a stipend to help cover laptop and home office equipment. Equity opportunities: Eligible employees in certain locations may receive equity compensation, subject to applicable plans and terms. Competitive, location-based compensation: Salary ranges vary by country. The advertised ranges include CA$85,000–CA$105,000 in Canada, £58,000–£65,000 in the United Kingdom, €50,000–€70,000 in Spain, R$240,000–R$320,000 in Brazil, €66,000–€85,000 in Ireland, ZAR 650,000–ZAR 900,000 in South Africa, €40,000–€50,000 in Portugal, and COP 137 million–COP 190 million in Colombia. Compensation for India is not specified in the provided posting and should be confirmed during the hiring process. Inclusive global culture: Join a distributed team that values trust, collaboration, diverse perspectives, flexibility, and equal access to professional opportunities. Meaningful impact: Contribute to a global mission focused on making employment opportunities more accessible and enabling businesses to work with talent across borders. How Jobgether Works We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. We appreciate your interest and wish you the best! Why Apply Through Jobgether? description: Job Description Role profile A strong, proactive Product Owner who can bridge Yorkshire Water business stakeholders and the technical squad. They need enough technical understanding to challenge and shape requirements, but the differentiator is their ability to engage the business, prioritise around value and confidently operate with senior stakeholders. Product ownership Demonstrable experience operating as a genuine Product Owner within a multidisciplinary technology/data squad. Requirements discovery Proactively engages users and stakeholders to uncover, challenge and translate business needs into clear requirements, rather than waiting for requirements to be handed over. Business-to-technical Able to translate between business outcomes and technical delivery, with sufficient technical understanding to know what is feasible and to challenge both sides constructively. Roadmap ownership Experience developing and maintaining a roadmap of capabilities across multiple releases/iterations, balancing immediate requirements with longer-term evolution. Value-led prioritisation Strong understanding of value-driven prioritisation and able to help stakeholders make explicit trade-offs between competing requirements. Senior stakeholder engagement Comfortable presenting to, questioning and facilitating senior stakeholders who will ultimately consume the reporting and insight products. Data/MI products Experience owning data, analytics, reporting, MI, dashboard or insight-oriented products. They do not need to be a Data Scientist, but should understand the delivery context. Squad working Comfortable working alongside engineers/data specialists and operating underneath an overall Product Manager rather than expecting to own the entire product function. Communication Clear, concise and credible communicator who can simplify technical subjects for non-technical audiences. Autonomy Able to take ownership, form a view and drive activity without requiring significant direction. Must demonstrate: Proactive rather than order-taking. Commercial/business-value mindset, not backlog administration. Comfortable challenging senior stakeholders constructively. Able to deal with ambiguity and turn loosely expressed needs into something deliverable. Strong judgement around value versus effort versus feasibility. Credibility with both technical teams and executives. Strategic enough to think beyond the next sprint. Confident facilitator who can bring conflicting stakeholder priorities to a decision.

Our focus is on driving large-scale transformations, improving end-to-end processes, and designing scalable, future-ready solutions that support our clients and investment teams. description: Job Purpose At Emirates, we believe in connecting the world, to and through, our global hub in Dubai; and in constantly innovating to ensure our customers ‘Fly Better’. Emirates Group IT thrives on the dynamic nature of technology. Being pioneers in aviation innovation, we're always at the forefront, pushing boundaries. We're on the lookout for exceptional IT professionals to fortify our position as leaders in the industry. Embark on a journey with the world’s largest international airline and become a vital part of our cutting-edge information and technology team as a Technical Product Owner. The Technical Product Owner (TPO) will be the front door to multiple product engineering teams, owning the backlogs of work spread across feature, function, non-functional (NFR), BAU, Technical Debt, spikes, and ceremonies. Leading and empowering their teams, the TPO acts as a voice of the customer, partnering with business counterparts to lead the lifecycle for designated technology products in the Airline Engineering, MRO, and Digital Aircraft operations domain. They are accountable for enabling the business to achieve its objectives & strategic outcomes from concept through to operations. In This Role, You Will Be Responsible for the story content, acceptance criteria definition, and end story "sign off" across team backlogs, ensuring prepared on time for future PIs, refined frequently with the entire team, and prioritised accordingly in alignment with other team backlogs. Ensures Technical Debt and Non-functional requirements are captured, refined, and prioritised across all sprints. Captures additional BAU, Ceremony, and Spike activities, and incorporates them into team backlogs, within the boundaries of available capacity. Prepare contribution to PI demo, in conjunction with other applicable Product Owners. Maintain the quality and integrity of features within their technical and team boundaries, ensuring identification and contribution of risks and dependencies back to the Product Portfolio backlog. Attends and contributes to key Product Management meetings, in particular PI Planning. Defines metrics to measure the success and performance of prioritised work, ensuring any further. BAU iterations can be proposed and prioritised accordingly within the boundaries of available capacity. Participates in establishing and growing a community of Product Owners, building an identity for the role, focusing on collaboration, and identifying opportunities for improvement and growth. Contribute to the Product Management Communities and their continual evolution to help drive efficient practices and empowered teams. Working with your team(s) to identify and capture team-driven innovation ideas, consolidating across peer groups for playback up to the TPM (Technical Product Manager) community. Qualification To be considered for this role, you must meet the below requirements: Degree or honours (12+3 or equivalent). 5+ years of experience in Information Technology or other. Knowledge/Skills Operations Research, Marketing Science, Information Systems, e-Commerce, or a combination of industry certification and 5+ years of relevant experience. Global Product (CSPO/SAFe/PSPO) trained and certified. 2+ years of practical experience working as a Product Owner/Manager, in a 'team-facing' capacity, with a proven record of driving discernible change and delivery at pace. Whilst not essential, some experience of working within a Scaled Agile framework, across multiple initiatives and circa 50+ teams. Demonstrated technical or domain expertise, utilising a depth and breadth of knowledge and practical experience within the specific domain or technical area. Stays up to date with regulatory and other changes in the technical area, and understands how they apply to the Emirates group. Well-versed with the tools for the Product Management aspects of software delivery. Strong and concise communicator at peer, line, and stakeholder levels. Builds strong relationships with peers and team members. Appetite for building and identifying value, with a customer centric mind-set. Leadership Role: Yes Salary & benefits Join us in Dubai and enjoy an attractive tax-free salary and travel benefits that are exclusive to our industry, including discounts on flights and hotel stays around the world. Find out what it’s like to live and work in our fast-paced, cosmopolitan home city in the Dubai Lifestyle section of our website www.emirates.com/careers.

description: About Aarika Real Estate Aarika Real Estate is a Dubai-based real estate agency helping buyers, sellers, tenants, and investors navigate the property market with confidence. We work with leading developers, including Emaar, DAMAC, Aldar, Sobha, Azizi, Ellington, and Deyaar, offering property sales, leasing, off-plan opportunities, and end-to-end client support. We are looking for a Growth Marketing Manager to drive qualified leads, strengthen marketing performance, and turn demand into viewings, transactions, and revenue. The Role You will own demand generation and growth across the entire property funnel, from the first ad impression or portal enquiry through lead qualification, property viewing, booking, and deal closure. Working closely with our sales and leasing teams, you will connect marketing activity directly to commercial outcomes. Your key performance metrics will include cost per qualified lead, cost per viewing, lead-to-deal conversion, customer acquisition cost, and revenue generated. This is a hands-on role for a commercially minded marketer who can manage paid campaigns, optimize conversion funnels, leverage CRM data, and build scalable growth strategies in Dubai's competitive real estate market. Key Responsibilities 1. Lead Generation & Paid Acquisition Plan, launch, and optimize performance campaigns across Meta, Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, and YouTube), TikTok, LinkedIn, and property portals such as Property Finder and Bayut. Develop campaigns for off-plan launches, secondary-market sales, rentals, and investor audiences. Manage marketing budgets and allocate spend based on lead quality, viewing rates, conversion, and revenue contribution. Build audience segments for first-time buyers, property investors, high-net-worth individuals, overseas buyers, landlords, and tenants. Test new channels, audiences, creatives, and acquisition strategies to improve campaign performance. 2. Funnel Optimization & Conversion Develop and optimize landing pages, project microsites, lead forms, WhatsApp enquiry flows, and property campaign pages. Build lead-nurturing journeys across email, WhatsApp, SMS, and retargeting to convert new, inactive, and long-cycle leads. Work with sales teams to define lead qualification criteria, scoring models, and response-time standards. Run continuous A/B testing across creatives, messaging, offers, landing pages, and forms. Identify bottlenecks throughout the funnel and implement improvements to increase enquiry-to-viewing and viewing-to-deal conversion rates. 3. CRM, Automation & Attribution Manage marketing automation and CRM workflows using platforms such as Bitrix24, Salesforce, or real estate-specific CRM systems. Ensure leads are tracked from their original source through qualification, viewing, offer, booking, and deal closure. Establish reliable marketing attribution to understand which channels, campaigns, and projects generate qualified leads and revenue. Build and maintain dashboards tracking CPL, cost per qualified lead, cost per viewing, lead-to-deal conversion, CAC, ROAS, and revenue by channel and project. Collaborate with sales teams to maintain accurate lead statuses, improve follow-up processes, and connect marketing spend to business results. 4. SEO, Content & Organic Growth Lead SEO strategy for property listings, community pages, area guides, and market insights to increase organic traffic and enquiries. Develop content strategies around property videos, walkthroughs, drone footage, developer projects, neighbourhood guides, market reports, and investor-focused topics. Create content that supports buyer and investor decisions, including rental yields, payment plans, mortgages, and ROI. Develop referral and partnership channels with developers, mortgage brokers, relocation firms, corporate partners, and broker networks. Strengthen the company's online reputation through client testimonials, reviews, success stories, and Google Business Profile management. 5. Campaigns, Launches & Events Plan and execute marketing campaigns for property launches, off-plan projects, open houses, roadshows, and investor events. Coordinate with developers, sales teams, and creative partners on campaign calendars, messaging, and marketing materials. Implement pre-event lead-generation strategies and post-event follow-up campaigns to convert interest into viewings and transactions. 6. Team & Stakeholder Management Coordinate and manage performance marketing, content, design, and external agency resources. Work closely with sales and leasing teams to align marketing priorities with inventory, commercial targets, and business objectives. Report campaign performance, budget utilization, pipeline contribution, and growth experiments to leadership on a weekly and monthly basis. Ensure marketing activities comply with applicable UAE real estate advertising regulations, relevant permit requirements, and data protection and consent obligations. Requirements: Must-Have At least 3 years of experience in growth marketing, performance marketing, or digital acquisition, including at least 2 years in real estate, proptech, property development, or another high-ticket, long-sales-cycle industry. Demonstrated success in generating qualified leads and contributing to closed revenue, beyond traffic and lead-volume metrics. Hands-on experience managing Meta Ads, Google Ads, and property portal campaigns. Strong budget management skills, with the ability to optimize spend against commercial targets. Practical experience with CRM systems and marketing automation, including lead tracking, scoring, attribution, and nurturing. Strong analytical skills and experience with GA4, Looker Studio, Tableau, Power BI, or similar reporting tools. Understanding of the property buyer and investor journey, including off-plan and ready properties, payment plans, mortgages, rental yields, and agent-led sales. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively with sales teams and agents. A data-driven, commercially focused mindset with a strong sense of ownership and accountability. Nice-to-Have Experience launching developer projects or running off-plan property campaigns in Dubai or other international markets. Familiarity with WhatsApp Business API, conversational marketing, and automated lead follow-up. Experience marketing to international buyers and high-net-worth investors across multiple markets. Knowledge of SEO and content strategy within the real estate sector. Familiarity with property listing syndication, virtual tours, lead-routing systems, and real estate technology platforms. What We Offer Competitive salary based on experience. Direct access to leadership and involvement in strategic growth, sales planning, and project launches. Budget ownership and the autonomy to test, optimize, and scale marketing initiatives. Opportunities for professional development and continuous learning. Employment visa and medical insurance in accordance with applicable UAE laws.

description: Real Estate Marketing Manager Christie’s International Real Estate is seeking a highly experienced, commercially driven Real Estate Marketing Manager to lead and oversee our secondary and off-plan marketing strategies across Dubai, Abu Dhabi and Ras Al Khaimah. We are looking for a proven performer who understands that successful real estate marketing is not simply about brand awareness - it is about generating qualified leads, securing listings, driving transactions and delivering measurable revenue. Key Responsibilities Secondary Market Marketing: Develop and execute targeted campaigns to generate seller enquiries, secure quality property listings and attract qualified buyers across our key communities. Off-Plan Marketing: Lead marketing strategies for developer projects, exclusive mandates, new launches and investment opportunities. Lead & Revenue Generation: Design and implement high-performing digital campaigns with a clear focus on lead quality, conversion rates, cost per acquisition and return on investment. Digital Marketing & Performance: Oversee Google Ads, Meta campaigns, SEO, property portals, social media and other performance-driven marketing channels. CRM and Lead Nurturing: Maintain efficient contact segmentation and manage email and WhatsApp sequences, newsletters and campaigns for new, warm, cold and dormant leads. Website and Enquiry Journeys: Keep website information current and ensure forms, landing pages and contact channels work properly. Brand Positioning: Maintain the exceptional standards of the Christie’s International Real Estate brand across all marketing materials, campaigns and digital platforms. Regional Marketing Strategy: Develop tailored marketing initiatives for Dubai, Abu Dhabi and Ras Al Khaimah, recognising the different market dynamics and buyer demographics. Market Research and Reporting: Monitor property market trends, competitor activity and demand, and produce market reports and insights to support marketing and sales. Sales & Marketing Alignment: Work closely with sales management and brokers to ensure marketing investment translates into genuine business opportunities and completed transactions. Agent Support and Sales Enablement: Coordinate agents’ marketing requests, including property brochures, presentations, listing promotions and other sales materials, ensuring timely delivery and brand consistency. Team Leadership & Reporting: Manage the marketing team and, where applicable, external agencies, setting clear priorities, allocating work and overseeing delivery. Manage marketing resources, budgets and campaign performance, providing clear reporting on leads, conversions, revenue attribution and ROI. The Ideal Candidate A proven track record in UAE real estate marketing, with particular expertise and demonstrated success in the secondary sales market. Strong experience in both luxury residential resale and off-plan property marketing. Demonstrable success in generating qualified buyer and seller leads that convert into revenue. In-depth understanding of UAE property portals, digital advertising platforms, CRM systems and lead-generation strategies. Commercially minded, analytical and results-oriented, with the ability to manage budgets effectively. Strong leadership, creative direction and strategic planning capabilities, including experience managing a marketing team and external agencies where applicable. description: About the Role: We’re looking for a Marketing Analyst to turn player data into retention and conversion gains. You’ll sit between marketing, CRM, product, and finance. Your job is to find where players drop off, work out why, and design and measure the fixes. You’ll lead on analysis and experimentation, and you’ll use AI to work faster and go deeper than a traditional analyst. Key Responsibilities Analyse the player lifecycle from registration through first purchase, repeat purchase, reactivation and churn. Report on cohort retention, LTV, ARPU and conversion by channel, state and segment. Identify high-value player behaviours and early churn signals. Build and maintain segments for CRM and reactivation campaigns. Design, run and read out A/B and multivariate tests across onboarding, first-purchase, offers and messaging. Recommend what to scale and what to stop. Work with the CRM and CRO teams to turn insights into campaigns, journeys and on-site changes. Track the incremental results. Measure the return on bonus and promotional spend, including bonus cost as a percentage of GGR, and recommend adjustments to protect margin. Build dashboards and regular reporting (daily, weekly, and monthly) so leadership can see retention and conversion performance at a glance. Use AI tools to automate analysis and reporting, speed up segmentation and surface patterns. You are expected to check their outputs critically. Support budget and forecasting work by modelling the effect of retention and conversion improvements on revenue and EBITDA. Follow responsible-gaming and data-privacy standards in all segmentation and targeting work. Requirements: Minimum 3 years’ experience as a marketing, CRM, retention, or product analyst or in an equivalent role. Proven track record of improving retention or conversion, shown by specific results. Strong SQL and spreadsheet skills, plus experience with a BI tool such as Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or Metabase. Hands-on experience with cohort analysis, funnel analysis, segmentation, and A/B testing, including a sound grasp of statistical significance. Demonstrable proficiency with AI tools, such as LLM assistants and AI-assisted analytics, in your day-to-day work. Be ready to give examples. Clear communicator who can present findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders. Based in, or willing to relocate to, Dubai, and able to work on-site in Business Bay. Preferred: Experience in iGaming (online casino and/or sports betting), including bonus mechanics, VIP or loyalty programmes and player lifecycle management. Familiarity with CRM and marketing automation platforms such as Braze, Optimove, Customer.io or similar. Experience with product analytics tools (Amplitude, Mixpanel, GA4) and attribution. Python or R for deeper analysis. Understanding of regulated or sweepstakes/social-casino environments. What success looks like (first 12 months): A 30% improvement in our first-month retention rate A 40% improvement in our repeat purchase rate A 30% improvement in our sign-up-to-purchase rate AI-assisted workflows that cut reporting time and improve segmentation quality
title: Marketing Analyst - Retention & Conversion
